question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

______! That looks disgusting.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Yikes"** is an informal expression of surprise or alarm, often used when something is shocking or disgusting. (हे भगवान!)

 
 
• **Example:** **Yikes!** That spider is huge!
 
 
 
• **"Wow" **is an expression of amazement or admiration. (वाह)
 
 
• **Example: Wow! **That fireworks display was incredible!
 
 
 
• **"Oops" **is an expression used when making a mistake or causing a minor accident. (अरे!)
 
 
• **Example:** **Oops!** I dropped the glass.
 
 
 
• **"Hush" **is an expression used to ask for silence. (चुप रहो)
 
 
• **Example: Hush**, the baby is sleeping.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Yikes**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wow** (वाह): An expression of amazement or admiration.

 
 
• **Example:** **Wow! **That painting is absolutely stunning.
 
 
 
• **Oops** (अरे!): An expression used when making a mistake or causing a minor accident.
 
 
• **Example:** **Oops!** I spilled coffee on my shirt.
 
 
 
• **Hush** (चुप रहो): An expression used to ask for silence.
 
 
• **Example:** **Hush,** we need to listen to the instructions carefully.
